Chapter 401: Chapter 14 Stupid! (Subscribe please)_2

“I’ve almost made my decision; I chose three people this time,” Lin Yuan nodded.

Not all challengers are selected by the Peak Masters. The vast majority of challengers are not chosen, but after joining the Red Kun Lineage, they strive to join a Peak Master through their postnatal efforts.

Just like ‘Fang Qing’ initially did not join any Peak Master’s command.

The same batch of Red Pattern Evolvers were quickly picked by some Peak Masters early on.

Being chosen early by a Peak Master equates to bypassing many detours.

“Which three?”

...

The fellow senior brothers immediately became interested.

They wanted to know which three challengers the junior brother with the remarkable talent had chosen.

“Mo Li, Feng Yu, Wu Lan,” Lin Yuan said directly.

Mo Li was one of the thirteen ranked Red Pattern Evolvers. When selecting him, Lin Yuan had discussed it with his senior brothers.

As a Red Pattern Evolver, Mo Li had notable talent, having formed a ‘Combat Heart’ at the Fourth Rank, with combat power far surpassing others of the same rank, ranking within the top three among the thirteen Red Patterns.

Combat Heart represents a certain realm, excelling in combat and innately close to rules related to slaughter.

As for Feng Yu and Wu Lan, one was a Golden Pattern, and the other was a Silver Pattern; Lin Yuan just casually picked them, taking those who caught his eye.

Feng Yu follows the Wind System Rules and is already near mastering it, standing out among Golden Pattern Challengers.

As for Wu Lan, she is a Silver Pattern Challenger. Lin Yuan chose her purely because she follows the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

Although the Martial Path Evolutionary Path is extremely famous in the Chikun Star Domain, it emerged too recently. There are some Third Rank Martial Arts Evolutionaries, but most are over a hundred years old.

Even if not over a hundred years old, they don’t necessarily participate in the arena competitions of the Chikun Star Domain.

Thus, seeing a Third Rank Martial Arts Evolutionary in this Seven Star Cave trial was quite rare, and Lin Yuan casually selected her.

“The junior brother’s choices… are quite patterned…” Upon hearing this, the Peak Masters looked at each other and couldn’t help but smile wryly.

One Red Pattern.

One Golden Pattern.

One Silver Pattern.

Isn’t it spreading benefits evenly?

“I chose randomly,” Lin Yuan said with a smile.

Aside from the Red Pattern, the remaining two were indeed chosen randomly.

“The Golden Pattern Challenger you picked seems to overlap with what the eldest senior brother chose?” The second senior brother seemed to think of something, and hastily said.

“Overlapped?”

The eldest senior brother was stunned, “Is it called Feng Yu?”

“Then I’ll let the junior brother have him,” the eldest senior brother said outright.

A mere Golden Pattern… even if it were a Red Pattern, if the junior brother desired it, the eldest senior brother would let it go outright.

“You don’t need to do this,” Lin Yuan immediately said.

“Let him choose for himself,” Lin Yuan thought for a while, letting the eldest senior brother concede, which also made him feel somewhat embarrassed.

“That’s fine.”

“Let Feng Yu choose for himself,” the eldest senior brother said, having no objections.

After all, it was just a Golden Pattern Challenger, nothing compared to their fraternity among the Peak Masters.

The other Peak Masters at the scene saw this and didn’t find it strange; it was just another Golden Pattern Challenger, and such challengers appeared every fifteen years, nothing special.

…

All the Evolvers who passed the Seventh Star Cave trial were teleported to a square.

Time passed.

In the blink of an eye, the Seven Star Cave trial ended.

At this moment, only a few thousand challengers were standing on this square.

From the initial over one hundred and fifty million to the present few thousand, the pass rate was roughly one thousandth.

At this time, the few thousand challengers standing there all had tense expressions.

Because what followed would be the moment that decided their destinies.

Everyone who passed the Seven Star Cave scene was now under the watch of the thirteen Peak Masters.

Based on performance, the thirteen Peak Masters would select a batch to join their command.

For everyone, this was akin to the chance of carp transforming into a dragon.

Being able to join a Peak Master directly meant bypassing many detours and attaining a significant position within the Red Kun Lineage.

…

Fang Qing’s figure appeared on this square.

“The three challengers the Peak Master wants to recruit…” As the ‘housekeeper’ of the current Thirteen Peaks, Fang Qing was specifically responsible for many matters atop the Thirteen Peaks.

After Lin Yuan informed him of the names of the challengers who had passed the Seven Star Cave trial, he was in charge of notifying them.

“The first, Silver Pattern Challenger Wu Lan…”

Fang Qing walked up to a nervous young girl and said gently, “The thirteenth Peak Master invites you to join Thirteen Peaks. If you wish, just enter through the thirteenth door later.”

After finishing his words, Fang Qing pointed towards the thirteen doors in the distance, where the thirteenth door belonged to the thirteenth Peak Master.

“I… I am willing…”

Wu Lan’s mind was a blur, and after coming to her senses, she hurriedly said excitedly.

My God.

She was actually noticed by the thirteenth Peak Master.

As a Silver Pattern Challenger, the probability of being selected by a Peak Master was very low, let alone by the famed thirteenth Peak Master known throughout the Chikun Star Domain and even the Annan Star Alliance?

Before participating in this arena competition, Wu Lan was already a fan of the thirteenth Peak Master; she hadn’t expected to be able to join Thirteen Peaks at this moment.

Wu Lan was somewhat dizzy from the unexpected benefit that befell her.

The other challengers around were looking at Wu Lan with envy.

But they could only envy, for whom the Peak Masters chose to pick was entirely up to the Peak Masters.

After notifying Wu Lan, Fang Qing then walked towards another challenger, Feng Yu.

“The thirteenth Peak Master also wants me to join?”

Feng Yu was a handsome man, who hesitated upon hearing Fang Qing’s words.

“Indeed.”

“If you agree, just enter through the thirteenth door later.”
